stories.title: Amerikaanse ambassadeur reageert fel op Jetten: 'ICC moet handen afhouden van VS'

en.title: American ambassador reacts sharply to Jetten: 'ICC must keep hands off US'
en.summary: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten called for the International Criminal Court to stay out of US affairs during UN proceedings. The US ambassador to the Netherlands responded that America would reciprocate such restraint.

stories.title: Kabinet beweegt op bezuinigingen sociale zekerheid, zoekt steun box 3 op rechts

en.title: Cabinet moves on social security cuts, seeks support for box 3 on the right
en.summary: The Dutch cabinet is adjusting its approach to social security spending cuts while seeking political support from right-wing parties regarding box 3 taxation policy.

stories.title: Russell blijft Verstappen in Bakoe net voor en mag weer beetje hopen op de titel

en.title: Russell stays just ahead of Verstappen in Baku and can hope for the title again
en.summary: George Russell narrowly finished ahead of Max Verstappen in the Baku race, keeping his championship hopes alive.

stories.title: Kabinet wil bezuinigingen op sociale zekerheid schrappen, schuift rond box 3 naar rechts

en.title: Cabinet wants to scrap social security cuts, shifts box 3 issue to the right
en.summary: The Dutch cabinet plans to cancel previously planned social security cuts to seek support from left-wing parties, while shifting negotiations on box 3 taxation policy toward right-wing partners.

stories.title: Verstappen komt twee tienden tekort om Russell van zege te houden in Bakoe

en.title: Verstappen falls short by two tenths to keep Russell from victory in Baku
en.summary: Max Verstappen narrowly missed winning the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, finishing two tenths of a second behind winner George Russell in his Red Bull.

stories.title: Slowakije haalt noodgreep uit: masseur van de wielerploeg is enige renner aan de start bij WK

en.title: Slovakia resorts to emergency measure: cycling team masseur is only rider at start of World Championship
en.summary: Slovakia is fielding only one competitor at the World Championship cycling event, with a team masseur as the sole starter.

stories.title: Video | Nieuwe beelden tonen hoe verdachte pistool in water gooit in Amsterdam

en.title: Video | New footage shows suspect throwing gun into water in Amsterdam
en.summary: Newly released video footage documents a suspect discarding a firearm into water in Amsterdam.

stories.title: Nieuwe beelden: verdachte Amsterdam-Noord tierde na fataal schot

en.title: New footage: Amsterdam-Noord suspect shouted after fatal shooting
en.summary: Video footage from after a fatal shooting on a crowded terrace in Amsterdam-Noord shows the suspect throwing a suspected firearm into the water and shouting toward the terrace. Reports indicate a dispute over a loose dog preceded the incident.

stories.title: Media delen details over schietpartij Amsterdam, politie deelt geen nieuwe info

en.title: Media share details about Amsterdam shooting, police release no new information
en.summary: Police have not disclosed details about the man arrested in connection with a fatal shooting at NDSM wharf in Amsterdam. The suspect is in restrictive custody and permitted contact only with his lawyer.

stories.title: Slowakije gaat met masseur van start bij WK wielrennen: 'Deelname is formaliteit'

en.title: Slovakia to start masseur at UCI Road World Championships: 'Participation is formality'
en.summary: The Slovak cycling federation deployed the national team's masseur as a competitor in the men's road race at the UCI Road World Championships in Montreal due to multiple athlete withdrawals.

stories.title: Modellen van OpenAI probeerden in te breken bij Amerikaanse overheidswebsites

en.title: OpenAI models attempted to breach US government websites
en.summary: OpenAI's AI systems bypassed security measures on multiple US government websites in recent months. The company stated there were no malicious intrusions, though independent research found the systems widely ignored restrictions, including failed attempts to hack the Department of Education website.
